verses.text: Ex kelemtak ab'ek, yujto tzex awtaji yik tzeyik' he jelanil, yik sk'ib' pax he pensar.
Yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i, t'a junok tzalan, ma t'a yol b'e, ma b'aj schalaj sb'a b'e, tzex awtaji.
Hanhejtona' t'a spuerta'il he chonhab', tzex awtajpaxi.
E masanil ex anima ayex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ab'ek.
Ex kelemtak to mantalaj he pensar, k'ayb'ejek he b'a t'a jelanil. Ex chuk he pensar, sayek jelan pensaril.
Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il, ol alchaj juntzanh tastak niwak yelk'och t'ayex, manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Te yel tas ol alchaj t'ayex, malaj tas tonhej ol nachajk'e'ok.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel tik wach'nhej, malaj jab'ok es t'ay.
Ha heb' jelan, sekojtak tz'aj snachajel juntzanh lolonel tik yuj heb'. Ha heb' ay spensar yojtak heb' tas syalelk'ochi.
Hak'ek eyip eyik'an he jelanil yet' aj pensaril, yujto yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata.
Yelxo wal te wach' jelanil t'a yichanh k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji yet' t'a yichanh junok tas snib'aj wal ochi.
Ha jelanil, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' wach' pensaril. Syak' kojtakejel juntzanh wach' razonal.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, sko chakkanel chukal. Tato jelan onh, max yal-laj kik'ancha'anh ko b'a. Max ko nib'ejochlaj chuk b'eyb'al yet' es.
Tato ay ko jelanil, syal ko na'an junok tas sko k'ulej t'a stojolal, tz'elnhejpaxk'ochi.
Ha yuj jelanil syak' yajalil heb' rey, tojol syutej heb' sch'olb'itan tastak yaj heb' yetanima'il.
Yuj jelanil chi', a heb' ayoch yajalil, wach' syutej heb' stanhwan schonhab', wach' pax syutej heb' sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima.
Ha mach sayanek' jelanil yet' smasanil sk'o'ol, tz'ilchaj yuj.
Yuj jelanil chi', tz'aj ko b'eyumal, tzonh b'inaj yuj, ay pax kelk'ochi.
Ha tas tz'ilchaj yuj jelanil chi', yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata sik'b'ileli.
Yuj jelanil, sko b'eyb'alej wach'ilal yet' tojolal.
Ha mach snib'an jelanil, ol yik' sb'eyumal yuj. Ol b'ut'jok spat yuj masanil tastak wach'.
Ha jelanil chi', aytaxonek'i ayik ix el yich smunlajel Jehová, ayik manto sb'o masanil tastak,
ayik manto sb'o yol yib'anhk'inal tik,
ayik mantalaj ha' niwak mar, mantalaj pax sjaj ha' niwak ha' sk'e'uli yet' pax sjaj ha' kotak ha'.
Ayik manto sb'olaj lum tzalkixtak yet' lum niwak witz, ayxo'ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ix yik'kanel yich jelanil Jehová ayik manto sb'olaj lum lum tik, mantalaj spokokal jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik ta'.
Ayik ix sb'o'ank'e satcha'anh masanto b'aj schalaj sb'a yet' ha' mar, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ayik ix sb'o'an asun ay t'a satcha'anh yet' pax yik ix syamanoch wa'an ha' mar,
ayik ix yalan t'a ha' mar chi' to manh ol el ha' b'aj aykani yet' pax ix yak'anem yich lum lum tik, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ha yuj sjelanil Dios ix sb'ok'e masanil tastak, ste tzalaj yuj tastak ix sb'o chi', yujto ha' sch'oxanel sjelanil.
Stzalaj yuj yol yib'anhk'inal yet' heb' anima sb'onak.
Haxo tikne'ik ex anima, ab'ek wal tas tz'alchaj t'ayex, b'eyb'alejek jelanil yik te wach' eyiko'.
Cha'ek eyab' he k'ayb'ub'al, manh he patikejel jelanil.
Te wach' yik mach scham wal yab'an lolonel yik jelanil,
yujto a mach tz'ilchaj jelanil chi' yuj, tz'ilchajpax sk'inal, syik'anpax swach'k'olal Jehová.
Palta a mach max cha'an yab' lolonel yik jelanil, munil syik'kot yahelal t'a yib'anh.
